prompt_en: A family around a Tet feast with a kumquat tree and red envelopes.
refined_prompt: A family around a Tet feast with a kumquat tree and red envelopes. A family gathering around a festive table spread with a traditional Vietnamese Tết feast, featuring a variety of dishes such as bánh chưng (square cakes), bánh tét (sticky rice cakes), and other regional specialties. A kumquat tree, symbolizing good luck and prosperity, stands nearby, with its bright orange fruits spilling onto the table. Red envelopes, filled with lucky money, are scattered among the dishes, awaiting distribution to family members and friends.
